data.name: Shivtej
data.long_meaning: Shiv Tej is a name that is derived from the combination of two words - 'Shiv' and 'Tej'. 'Shiv' is the name of the Hindu god of destruction and is considered the supreme god of the Hindu pantheon. 'Tej' means 'victory' or 'power'. Therefore, Shiv Tej can be interpreted as 'Shiva's Victory' or 'Shiva's Power'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shiv Tej is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It signifies the victory of the divine over the mundane and the triumph of spirituality over materialism. It is also a name that is believed to bestow the bearer with the blessings of Lord Shiva and the strength and power to overcome any obstacle in life.

in_hindi.name: शिवतेज
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव (Shiva) - गOD OF DESTROYER AND CREATOR, तेज (Tej) - RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE. SO, शिवतेज (Shivtej) MEANS 'GOD SHIVA WITH RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE'.
